videos.name: Family Statements
videos.overview: As he prepares for an emotional court appearance, Tom buries himself in the case, while Emily questions her obligations to the family. Later, Maeve makes a critical choice to protect her own family, while Robbie works to find a way to turn his newfound surplus into cash.

Meanwhile, Perry searches for answers within the gang and uncovers a shocking truth. Later, Maeve casts doubt on Robbie's exit plan.
